_doc: GP-MESSAGE-JOURNAL (owner, 2026-10-26): what the journal's Messages page keeps of the messages shown to a player, read by MessageJournal (game/scripts/core/message_journal.gd). A message is recorded only when its source gives it one of these categories; an untagged message (routine interface feedback: a target chosen, a refusal, a menu answer) is shown and not kept. Each player keeps at most 'cap' entries of each tier; past it the oldest entry of that tier goes, so ordinary entries never push out significant ones. Agent decision, provisional for the owner (docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-26).
